name.en-US: Letter on the Imitation of Christ
name.pt-BR: Carta sobre a imitação de Cristo

description.la: Epistola de imitatione Christi. Textus ex editione Quaracchi (Opera omnia VIII, 1898), ex scanno OCR, sine notis criticis.
description.en-US: A letter on the imitation of Christ. The Latin is the Quaracchi edition (Opera omnia VIII, 1898) from an OCR scan, without the editors’ critical notes.
description.pt-BR: Carta sobre a imitação de Cristo.

sources.edition: S. Bonaventurae Opera omnia, tom. VIII (Ad Claras Aquas, Quaracchi: Collegium S. Bonaventurae, 1898), pp. 499-503.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR (djvu.xml word coordinates) of the folio edition. Each page is read in two columns; marginal notes, running heads, the editors’ footnotes (variant readings, cross-references) and small-type scholia are removed by layout (line pitch and measure); line-end hyphens are joined; recognisable OCR slips are corrected by a lexicon pass, so some remain.
sources.tierEvidence: Bonaventure died in 1274; the Quaracchi edition of 1898 is public domain.
